title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Program Synthesis for Quasi-Monte Carlo Design
venue: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations

publication.venue: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided evolutionary synthesis of low-discrepancy point-set generators and Sobol direction-number programs
mechanism.populationDetail: The experimental setup explicitly reports a population of 60 programs organized as a multi-island evolutionary system with occasional migration; island count and migration policy are not given in the accessible paper.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The setup mentions occasional archive sampling, but does not define whether it is an elite archive, its size, preservation rule, or relation to island populations.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The general loop says each newly generated and evaluated program is added to the population; survivor pruning and archive update rules are not specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: The LLM rewrites core program functions from a selected parent (large-scale modification) and receives additional high-performing inspirations explicitly intended to encourage crossover, although whether these are genealogical parents or contextual references is underspecified.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The parent prompt includes the parent program's fitness score, which is objective feedback rather than additional evaluator metadata or verbalized critique.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Parents are chosen by fitness, with occasional archive sampling. The generic method describes one focal parent plus additional high-performing inspirations; exact count, sampling distribution, and archive semantics are not provided.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/LLM-Guided Evolutionary Program Synthesis for Quasi-Monte Carlo Design.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Survey cites qmcdesign for manually scheduled exploration-to-exploitation and fitness-based parent selection. The PDF available here omits the referenced Appendix B, so exact LLM identity, archive design, parent/inspiration count and sampling probabilities cannot be verified. Inspirations are said to encourage crossover, but full prompt semantics are unavailable.
